sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct is Liquid AI's flagship instruction-tuned model, delivering exceptional performance for chat, instruction-following, and tool-calling tasks. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning.

sources.title: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct | Model Library | Overmind
sources.snippet: Overview LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct is Liquid's flagship small instruct model — 28T-token pretrain plus multi-stage RL, ChatML tool calling, and day-one support for Transformers, vLLM, and llama.cpp. Strong on agentic tasks and RAG; not aimed at heavy coding or knowledge-intensive work.

sources.title: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct · Models
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct LFM2.5 is a new family of hybrid models designed for on-device deployment. It builds on the LFM2 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning. Best-in-class performance: A 1.2B model rivaling much larger models, bringing high-quality AI to your pocket. Fast edge inference: 239 tok/s decode on AMD CPU, 82 tok/s on mobile NPU. Runs under 1GB of memory ...

sources.snippet: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct is a compact, high-performance instruction-tuned model built for fast on-device AI. It delivers strong chat quality in a 1.2B parameter footprint, with efficient edge inference and broad runtime support.
